id.description: A mesh, material or bone Id (ADR 0005): ASCII, at most 63 bytes, no leading, trailing or doubled underscore.

quat.description: A rotation as [x, y, z, w].

color.description: [r, g, b, a] exactly as set on the game material, sRGB-encoded.

extensions.description: Game Extensions. KK and KKS write 'kk'; 'kks' holds anything only KKS has. A Game-only field is added only when a Step or Hook reads it.

kk.description: No Game-only data is defined for this section, so this must be empty.

kks.description: No Game-only data is defined for this section, so this must be empty.

svs.description: No Game-only data is defined for this section, so this must be empty.
